title: Clícalo profile template
description: One installable profile template per file, so the community can contribute through review (CAT-006). Its id equals the file name and, with the version, forms the CatalogRef of installed shortcuts (DAT-004).

version.description: Increases with every change of the template.

appsLanguages.description: Program languages whose shortcuts were reviewed; tap variants override the keys for a language (CAT-005, PLA-015 [onlyEs]).

processes.description: Processes the profile binds to (PER-002). Several per profile await decision PQ-45.
